archived_from: Previously completed in-memory probe stdout; no market simulations were rerun for this archive.
source_hash_limitation: No immutable pre-run source snapshot was created. These hashes identify the current source at archival time; this diagnostic did not modify market source.

output_precision.mean_moments: Rounded to 6 decimal places in the original stdout; unrounded vectors were not persisted.
output_precision.seconds: Rounded to 3 decimal places; includes stepping, validation and diagnostic statistics.

return_convention: Simple price returns for MSM moments; dividends enter cash conservation but are not included in price returns.

gates.mechanical: All dates: finite positive price/value paths, zero price caps, relative cash error and daily maximum absolute share error <=1e-8.
gates.core_stylized: All 200 assets: finite nine-moment vector, excess kurtosis >0, absolute-return ACF1 >0.
gates.return_acf: Descriptive; no caller threshold was supplied.
gates.correlations: Descriptive; no empirical range or gate was supplied.
gates.empirical_calibration: pending for every configuration; no held-out empirical target evaluation.

decomposition.normalization: For each asset, center component c_j,t and lagged total log return r_t-1 over post-burn-in adjacent observations; divide their covariance by sd(r_t)*sd(r_t-1). Then average across assets.
decomposition.identity: With zero price caps, contributions sum to the mean per-asset Pearson lag-1 log-return correlation.
limitations: This is a covariance decomposition, not an independent causal intervention or variance-share allocation.
The noise_persistence_0 configuration had one capped price move; its residual permanent-flow component also contains clipping adjustment.
The sum differs slightly from MSM return_acf_1 because MSM uses simple returns and its own autocorrelation normalization.
No confidence intervals or cross-seed variability were estimated.

validator_edge_checks.short_window_explanation: The reused compute_moments/Hill estimator rejects insufficient samples. The validator reports failed finite-moment gates with nulls rather than certifying a short window.
validator_edge_checks.negative_direction: No DomainSpec, raw score, goodness or direction is read by validate_market; only market price/value paths and MarketConfig are used.

limitations: One repeatedly inspected development seed (20261012), not calibration and not fresh-seed acceptance.
These one-at-a-time perturbations are not a systematic parameter search or an identified parameter estimate.
No original reports or market defaults were overwritten.
Correlations are descriptive and have not been compared with held-out empirical data.
Core stylized PASS only checks the explicit sign gates, not full nine-moment empirical fit.
Changing rebalancing speed or permanent impact also changes the firm marginal-signal-value channel; downstream policy results must be rechecked after any accepted market change.
